entry.title: When the connection drops mid-booking: session resumption on Gemini Live, measured
entry.summary: A pending tool call survives a working resume on Gemini 3.8 Live, but after a silent loss every resume was refused for 15 minutes. A client-side recovery, measured.

entry.title: Making “stop” work on Gemini 3.8 Live: a client-side commit guard, measured
entry.summary: A client-side guard for in-flight tool calls on Gemini 3.8 Live, tested with speech: bookings after “stop” fell from 12 of 12 runs to 0 of 12. Design, ablations, limits.

entry.title: What “stop” does to an in-flight tool call on Gemini 3.8 Live
entry.summary: Thirty Gemini 3.8 Live sessions, with text and speech: no tool-call cancellation arrived for a pending booking, and BLOCKING mode booked twice. Method, timings, limits.

entry.title: RoboLLM: diagnosing failed reaching, measuring a repair
entry.summary: From targeting defects to arm collisions: a frozen simulation repair reaches 35/100 targets versus 0/100, with complete traces, replay and explicit limits.
